data.one_liner: A dialog widget that supports multi-page navigation and dynamically animates its size and alignment.
data.what_it_does: FluidDialog allows developers to show dialogs that can switch between multiple pages using a custom navigator. It automatically and dynamically animates the size and alignment of the dialog container as its content changes.
use_when: You need a multi-step wizard or form inside a dialog.
You want dialog size and alignment transitions to animate smoothly between pages.
avoid_when: You only need a simple, single-view alert dialog.
You require standard platform-specific native dialog implementations.
strengths: Supports animated size and alignment transitions out of the box.
Includes a built-in DialogNavigator for multi-page flows within the dialog.
weaknesses: Not documented for complex non-dialog bottom sheets or full-screen navigation.
